name: core-numbering
description: Numbering, a number a person reads on each instance (D56): its format's tokens and padding, the configs it refuses at define, a count with no gap a refused create leaves, counts per scope target and per year, a list's filters on the number and the label through their indexes, assignNumber's backfill, the rule that nothing changes a number, the rule for a new version, its guidance, and Revisions beside it.

Absent when the instance holds none.

seq.description: The instance's number in its count, from 1; absent until it is numbered.

s15.name: Links
s15.description: Named links from the instance to instances of the schemas its config names, set by link or given at create: each holds one target, or with many a list of them. A pinned link records the target's revision (its schema composes Revisions) or its release (its schema composes Branches), and reports the target's latest beside it and whether the target has moved past it. A required link is given at create, can be moved to another target but not unlinked, and the delete of its target is refused; a required many-valued link keeps at least one target, and only its last target's delete is refused. A deleted target leaves every link that holds it.
s15.summary: Each Invoice links to other instances by name: customer to Customer (required) and referrer to Customer. Every create gives customer; a required link is moved, never unlinked, and the instance it points at cannot be deleted.

shared.s16: A number a person reads on each instance, set in its create's transaction from a count per namespace and schema: the format prints it, INV-{yyyy}-{seq:4} as INV-2026-0042. The count may run per target of a required, single-valued link and start again each UTC year, so a label is unique within its scope. A refused create takes no number; a delete leaves a gap. Nothing changes a number once set, and a list finds an instance by its label or its number. An instance made before its schema composed Numbering is numbered by assignNumber.

behaviors.name: Numbering
behaviors.summary: Each Invoice gets a number at its create, in a count per target of its customer link, starting again at 1 each UTC year, printed as INV-{yyyy}-{seq:4}: number 42, made in 2026, prints INV-2026-0042. A label is unique among one customer target's instances. A refused create takes no number, a delete leaves a gap, and nothing changes a number once set.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Invoice
operations.description: Creates a Invoice: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given. behaviors gives its behaviors their create parameters (Links), which hold from the create on.

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Invoice: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one. behaviors gives Links their create parameters, which hold from the create on. behaviors.Links gives the links from the create, by name (customer and referrer): each the target's id. customer is required.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. The new Invoice holds behaviors.Numbering.seq, the next number of its count, and label, the number as INV-{yyyy}-{seq:4} prints it. It is counted in the count of the customer target the create gives.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Invoice
operations.description: Lists Invoice instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Invoice instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title, note, Numbering.seq or Numbering.label; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's. where: { "Numbering.label": "INV-2026-0042" } finds an instance by the number a person reads, and "Numbering.seq" by its number. Each customer target counts from 1, so a label can match one instance per target.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

operations.name: link
operations.title: Invoice: link
operations.description: Points a link at an instance of its schema, replacing the target it had; a many-valued link adds the instance to its list, or pins again one it holds. A pinned link records the target's latest revision or release, or the one given.

guidance.useWhen: Use to point customer or referrer at an instance of its schema, moving it when it is set.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use at create; give the links in behaviors.Links instead.
guidance.success: Returns the link: its name, schema, id and the revision or release a pinned link records. Moving customer keeps the instance's number, which stays in the count of the target it was numbered under.

operations.name: assignNumber
operations.title: Invoice: assignNumber
operations.description: Numbers an instance created before its schema composed Numbering, in the count of the year it was created in, as its create would have. On an instance numbered already it changes nothing and returns its number. A deployment backfills by invoking it in creation order.

label.description: The number as the format prints it.

guidance.useWhen: Use on an instance created before Invoice composed Numbering, which holds no number yet; to backfill, invoke it on each in creation order.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to renumber: an instance numbered already keeps its number, and the call changes nothing.
guidance.success: Returns seq and label, counted as its create would have counted them, by its customer target, in the year it was created; behaviors.Numbering holds them from then on.

behaviors.name: Numbering
behaviors.summary: Each Invoice gets a number at its create, in one count for Invoice, printed as No. {seq}: number 42 prints No. 42. A label is unique. A refused create takes no number, a delete leaves a gap, and nothing changes a number once set.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: The instance's number in its count, from 1; absent until it is numbered.

fields.name: label
fields.description: The number as the format prints it, unique within its scope; absent until it is numbered.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Invoice
operations.description: Creates a Invoice: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given. behaviors gives its behaviors their create parameters (Links), which hold from the create on.

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Invoice: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one. behaviors gives Links their create parameters, which hold from the create on. behaviors.Links gives the links from the create, by name (customer and referrer): each the target's id. customer is required.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. The new Invoice holds behaviors.Numbering.seq, the next number of its count, and label, the number as No. {seq} prints it.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Invoice
operations.description: Lists Invoice instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Invoice instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title, note, Numbering.seq or Numbering.label; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's. where: { "Numbering.label": "No. 42" } finds an instance by the number a person reads, and "Numbering.seq" by its number.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

operations.name: link
operations.title: Invoice: link
operations.description: Points a link at an instance of its schema, replacing the target it had; a many-valued link adds the instance to its list, or pins again one it holds. A pinned link records the target's latest revision or release, or the one given.

guidance.useWhen: Use to point customer or referrer at an instance of its schema, moving it when it is set.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use at create; give the links in behaviors.Links instead.
guidance.success: Returns the link: its name, schema, id and the revision or release a pinned link records.

operations.name: assignNumber
operations.title: Invoice: assignNumber
operations.description: Numbers an instance created before its schema composed Numbering, in the count of the year it was created in, as its create would have. On an instance numbered already it changes nothing and returns its number. A deployment backfills by invoking it in creation order.

label.description: The number as the format prints it.

guidance.useWhen: Use on an instance created before Invoice composed Numbering, which holds no number yet; to backfill, invoke it on each in creation order.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to renumber: an instance numbered already keeps its number, and the call changes nothing.
guidance.success: Returns seq and label, counted as its create would have counted them; behaviors.Numbering holds them from then on.

scenarios.name: Numbering (node) > beside Revisions: an approved proposal keeps the number, and a revision holds the own fields alone
